source_finding: _c1_closed_bar requires current money at the bar boundary and retains no bar when money is None. Later _c1_quote receives fresh money but returns when confirmation is None; it never reevaluates that completed H4. An already stored confirmation is NOT discarded merely because a quote has stale money: current_money None returns without clearing it.
actual_cause: A funding AccountState at the H4 timestamp invalidates the older checkpoint whose source is H4 minus one minute. The native coherent trace contains real post-funding cash at the closed boundary; the first next receipt commits it with source equal to the H4 boundary. No observed DD40, price, reclaim or numerical margin gate blocks fresh reevaluation in these two windows.

strict_preservation_requirement: Retain only completed market bar identity/close and the actual cut terminal basis. Never reuse cached cash as fresh. On the first fully fresh matching receipt/quote, recheck DD40, cut VWAP reclaim, state/group/credit, fill epoch/account source freshness, ordinary priority/native owner, original rights and native increase gates. Await a real cancel ACK before submission. Expire on invalidating fill, ordinary revocation, group change or terminal event. No new TP rights, larger threshold or extra attempt.
qualification_limit: Finite evidence proves event-scheduling loss and an earlier state-machine decision. It does not prove an observed new fill or economic result. Exact next-quote RESTORE submission remains UNKNOWN because the earlier TP cancellation was never requested and its ACK does not exist in actual output. No native/full GO or product edit is issued.
